thread:
Mira: Heads-up — p99 TTFT on the token-level dashboard spiked ~2.2x in eu-west-2 over the last hour :eyes:. Grafana panel `infra/ttft-by-region` shows a sharp tail. Anyone else seeing KV-cache misses correlate with that?
Alex: saw it too, noticing higher tokens/sec per shard during the period. Could be autoscaler flapping nodes + batching changes.
Jonas: I pulled the query: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{env=\"prod\"}[5m])) by (le, region))` — p99 on west2 jumped to 480ms from ~200ms.
Emily: also seeing increased `tokens_generated_total` rate: `sum(rate(tokens_generated_total{region=\"eu-west-2\"}[1m]))` went from ~30k/s to ~85k/s for ~10m. That aligns with the spike window.
Mira: interesting — if tokens/sec jumped that much, batching might have increased queueing. But the shape looks like packet drops too. Any network errors in node logs? 
Alex: I grep'd kube-proxy and nvidia-smi logs — a few ENETUNREACH in the nodes that serviced those shards. Logs: ```Mar 12 15:02:13 node-54 kernel: [drop] ENETUNREACH -> pod xg-serve-73 grpc failed```
Jonas: ENETUNREACH + autoscaler churn can yield cold KV cache misses which blow up TTFT. We saw this pattern before with the west2 NIC firmware regression.
Mira: Can we add a Grafana drilldown panel that overlays `tokens/sec`, `p95`, `p99`, and `node_restarts` for a single shard? Right now panels are separated and hard to correlate. :memo:
Grafana-Bot: New panel created in temp dashboard `ops/ttft-correlation` (url: https://grafana.redwood/ops/d/zt7x/ttft-correlation). Use the vars `region=eu-west-2, shard=hot-*`.
Emily: Nice. For alerts, p99 SLO current alert fires at 400ms for 5m. We probably need to avoid noisy pager during transient token bursts — suggest changing alert to `for: 15m` and add a `tokens/sec > X` suppression rule. :thinking_face:
Alex: Agree. Proposed alert tweak: `expr: increase(tokens_generated_total[5m]) > 200000 and histogram_quantile(0.99, ...) > 0.4` and `for: 10m`. That ties latency to sustained token load.
Jonas: Also add a label to split by `model_family` — quantized models behave differently (bigger token/sec, lower per-token compute).
Mira: Ops action: (1) add suppression rule + increase `for` to 10m; (2) add overlay panel and share link; (3) run a perf sweep on west2 NIC images for the nodes that had ENETUNREACH. Who wants (3)?
Jonas: I can take the node image sweep and open an infra ticket. I'll include NIC firmware version, kube-proxy logs, and GPU driver versions.
Emily: I'll update the alerting PR with Alex's proposed expr and add a short writeup for on-call playbook (how to correlate tokens/sec vs p99).
Mira: Thanks — let's reconvene if it recurs. Adding `ops:action` tag on the ticket. :thumbsup:
